body:
Closed the first, dominant half of the match gap flagged in every prior selfhost entry. Hardcoded the Ok/Some=1, Err/None=0 tag mapping (VS0's two builtin two-variant enums) rather than building a general defenum tag registry. Scrutinee: bare symbol or plain-call-shaped? call, evaluated once into a block-scoped Result/Option local. 2-clause exhaustive dispatch, payload bound to a real void* local. Added Result/Option as param-c-type cases too. 9 new tests (44 total for domain 4), real compile+run+assert check. Zero regressions. Commit f4d3eb3.

⚓ ☃
title: selfhost/emit.prn: real Result/Option match support (tail-position, tag dispatch)
